name: Suki na Mono wa Suki Dakara Shouganai!! 3 -RAIN-
original_name: 好きなものは好きだからしょうがない!! 3 -RAIN-
source:
Up to advanced class and all things settled satisfactory...
No! No! No time taking rest! New troubles happened a lot.
"The campus tinkers" appeared!!!
It's our copy cat?
Come on! I'll debunk who they are! Let's go Fujimori!
translation:
顺利升入高年级，一切也都圆满解决了……
不！不！不！现在还不是休息的时候！新的麻烦接踵而来。
“校园恶作剧二人组”出现了！！！
他们是在模仿我们吗？
来吧，我一定要揭穿他们的真面目！我们走，藤守！
